checks.name: Independent recovery acceptance is signed, armed and verified before any controller change
Every target reads back exactly one independent controller with an unchanged module
Independent lifecycle reader still authenticates every fenced target and sees the handover
Fencing the witness preserves its recovery journal unchanged
Former operator is refused control reads, re-adding itself, reinstalling and upgrading every target
An unrelated principal cannot read or change control of any fenced target
Fencing the witness itself invalidates the earlier signed acceptance until a fresh one is armed
Fencing changes who controls code, not what the canister still refuses or serves
A fresh signed acceptance restores recovery reads under fenced lifecycle counts; fencing is reversible
Changing control of a participant alone, with the witness untouched, invalidates the signed acceptance
Exclusive control returns only through the fence, leaving the accepted journal intact
